messages:
maria_sales: FYI — Oratorio (music SaaS) wants a quick preflight for a POC. new model vendor: melody-13b-v1, they need private deployment, low-latency embeddings, and model variants for hallucination reduction. can we run a compatibility sweep?
aj_engineering: Can do a tech sweep. quick questions: is the vendor providing quantized weights, or do we need to quantize? seq len expectations?
devon_se: They're asking for int8 quant and KV cache support. seq_len ~1024 typical, but one test uses 2048 for long-context scoring. also they want KMS integration for keys.
leah_solutions: Also any enterprise blockers — SSO + SOC2 + legal NDA turnaround. They're worried about inference costs for heavy embedding traffic.
aj_engineering: For melody-13b-v1: we need to validate kernel compatibility and attention pattern. If vendor supplied int8, great — but we should validate the quant scheme (symmetric/asymmetric) before recommending. I can run a quick perf sweep on a 4-GPU dedicated pool.
maria_sales: timeline: demo next Tue. can we get a go/no-go by EOD Friday? client decision hinges on whether we can do private VPC + KMS + acceptable latency.
aj_engineering: I'll run two passes: 1) variant compatibility check (float32 vs int8 vs q4_0) 2) KV cache behaviour with 1024/2048 lengths. will post logs.
devon_se: Security: I started the security questionnaire. A couple answers flagged — need confirmation on customer-managed KMS, data residency, and audit log retention. tagging sec_bot for anything automatic.
sec_bot: auto-check complete — SOC2 answer: "in progress; SOC2 Type II available upon request". KMS: supports customer-managed keys via KMS integration; need config snippet from infra team.
leah_solutions: Pricing note: Oratorio expects mid-six-figure annual commitment for Dedicated. finance_bot, what uplift for private + KMS + longer retention?
finance_bot: Ballpark uplift: private deployment base +20% over hosted, KMS + audit retention adds fixed surcharge depending on storage tier. I'll DM a line-item estimate.
aj_engineering: Quick config I'm trying on the dedicated pool:
```yaml
model: melody-13b-v1
variants:
  - name: float32
  - name: int8
  - name: q4_0
kv_cache: enabled
seq_lengths: [1024, 2048]
quant_scheme: vendor-provided
```
aj_engineering: Early run suggests q4_0 reduces memory by ~40% and latency impact is +10-15ms per token vs float32; int8 vendor weights slightly faster but we need to validate logits fidelity for hallucination-sensitive prompts.
maria_sales: Good — can you check model fallback policy? client wants deterministic fallback to a smaller variant if latency spikes.
aj_engineering: We can set routing policy: primary -> melody-13b-v1-int8, fallback -> melody-7b-slim (same family). will configure canary rollout and autoscale thresholds.
devon_se: Security blocker: legal wants explicit E2E encryption assurance for keys in transit and at rest, and a signed MOU for data deletion on contract termination. Leah, can you escalate?
leah_solutions: Escalating legal now. also asking client if they can accept a dedicated-hosted hybrid while SOC2 papers are finalized.
ops_oncall: Notes from infra: VPC peering + private endpoint is straightforward. KMS requires IAM policy for cross-account decrypt; share the Oratorio KMS ARN and we can set a key policy. Also, we need to pre-provision burst capacity for embedding workload — recommend reserved lanes.
aj_engineering: I'll upload perf traces and token-level latency tomorrow morning. If anyone wants the raw run command it's: `./run-compat --model melody-13b-v1 --variant=int8 --seq=2048 --kv-cache`
maria_sales: Thanks all. Friday EOD for go/no-go — devon, legal, finance, ops: any concrete red flags that would block the demo? quick answers please. :eyes:
devon_se: Legal requested MOU and data deletion clause — blocker until signed. also need confirmation on KMS ARN.
finance_bot: Pricing ok to present as estimate; final needs signed SOW.
leah_solutions: I'll try to get legal sign-off draft by Thu evening.
aj_engineering: No perf red flags so far. small quality regression with int8 on hallucination prompts — can mitigate with reranker + prompt engineering for the demo.
maria_sales: OK — next steps: aj run final perf pass tomorrow, devon follow up on KMS ARN, leah push legal, finance prep estimate. I'll consolidate into a short exec summary for Oratorio. :rocket:
sec_bot: Reminder: attach security questionnaire export to the thread once updated.
maria_sales: will do. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
